text: Touch down on the {name}, the glow-up is real.
Glow-Up Age hits and the Bronze theme unlocks. Iconic, no cap.
Aesthetic Age, and the Parchment theme unlocks. Main character lighting.
Group Chat Age, and the Monochrome theme unlocks. Read receipts off, vibes on.
Cyber Baddie Age opens the Cyberpunk theme. Netrunner energy, zero chill.
Galaxy Brain Age unlocks the Cosmic theme. Big brain, bigger sky.
Put the {name} up and make it a moment.
Keep {count} of the {name}'s buildings standing before you bounce out of it. Wonders don't count, sorry.
Hold {count} of the Final Boss Age's buildings standing before you prestige. Wonders don't count, the boss is picky.
Build {count} {lname} buildings across every run, no cap. Sold and rebuilt copies count once.
Clock {count} {lname} workers in at the same time, that's the grind.
Post {count} soldiers on duty at the same time, the perimeter is bussin.
Stack {count} soldiers on post at once, the vibe check is brutal.
Mint {count} {lname} across every run. Trades, loot and gifts don't count, they're not the grind.
Deploy {count} {lname} across every run, the squad goals are real.
Station {count} {lname} across all your runs, locked in.
Send out {count} {lname} across every run, no bench warmers.
Field {count} {lname} across all your runs, the roster is stacked.
Run into the {name} and make it a meet-cute.
Become besties with the {name}, the pact is sealed.
Snag 5 deals from the {name} across your runs, they know your order.
End a war with the {name}, by tribute or by ghosting it until it dies.
Appease while {name} is mid-monologue, no notes.
Pick Endure against {mid} and keep grinding with whatever is left, no cap.
Succumb to {mid} and restart with its legacy, the reset hits different.
Make it back from a successful {word} mission in the {name}, slay.
Age up in the {name} theme and let the fit do the talking.
Catch {mid} in the wild, what a plot twist.
Peace out of the {name} inside its pacing target, speedrun energy.
Prestige out of the last age of the Cosmic Era inside the era's pacing target, speedrun or bust.
Endure the Last Passage, then prestige with the scraps. Still a W.
At the Last Passage, Succumb and carry its legacy into every run. It's a whole arc.
Ascend out of the Cosmic Era and let the Last Passage show up to an empty room.
Plain ascii glyphs, minimalist and unbothered, age up.
Unicode glyphs, the boxes are doing a lot, age up.
Nerd Font glyphs, the icons go hard, age up.
Hoard 30 Crash Pads standing before you leave the Touch Grass Age. The 30th costs 693 Sticks, 34 times the first.
Line up 31 Crash Pads standing in the Touch Grass Age. There is no 32nd: the storage won't hold that price, the math is the math.
Something about Crash Pads, no spoilers.
Own 5 Stash Spots standing before you leave the Touch Grass Age.
Roll into the Doomscroll Age without picking Endure once, pure main character energy.
Land in the Smoke Szn Age with the build plan never starting a thing. Self-made era.
Bounce from the Glow-Up Age without upgrading a single building in the run, grandma would be proud.
Get to the Doomscroll Age inside four fifths of the combined pacing target of the twelve ages before it, the speed is unreal.
Up before the group chat: the Sharp Drip Age arrives inside the combined pacing target of the three ages before it.
Spend ten times the Touch Grass Age's pacing target inside the Touch Grass Age. The late entrance was the whole plan.
Playing it cool: Endure a catastrophe with Brace at level 2, unbothered.
Go into a catastrophe with no Brace and no Guard Town, then Endure it. Pure chaos energy.
The Guard Town saves buildings during an Endure, it's the MVP.
Invite a catastrophe, then Endure it, we love a self-inflicted arc.
Bring on a catastrophe, then Succumb to it, the vibe is cursed.
Two rounds of Appease on a harbinger and the catastrophe still shows up. Rude, we gave it snacks.
Appease a harbinger, only to learn it made the whole thing up. Rough.
Rumor has it: a wasted offering, bestie.
Invite doom on a fake prophet's word and get it anyway, the manifesting is real.
Word on the street: manifesting drama.
Brace to level 2 and get spared, the prep paid off.
All three voices of one era's warning in one thread. The group chat got loud.
Ignore a harbinger completely and still come out clean. Read, not replied.
Summon the Last Passage on purpose. Bold move, no notes.
Pair Brace at level 2 with Endure at the Last Passage, and walk out in one piece.
Prestige five times while holding Cosmic Legacy, generational wealth energy.
Your Guard Town blunts 30 raids in one run, the goons are built different.
Settle a war by paying tribute, the receipt is the peace treaty.
Let a war die on its own, no tribute, no drama, just ghosting.
Be at war with two civilizations at once, dramatic and unbothered.
Lore drop: a lot of frenemies.
Ally with every civilization you have met, at least four of them. The squad is massive.
Get workers on loan from a civilization, hand-me-down labor, we'll take it.
Lock in 10 deals with one civilization in one run. The loyalty is documented.
Make a deal at the black market, shady but iconic.
Come back after the full offline allowance to find the build plan started 10 or more items and ran out of ideas.
Ghost the game past the offline allowance. It stopped counting before you came back, respect the boundaries.
Show up on 7 different days within 10 days, consistency is the whole bit.
Log in on 30 different days, the streak is unreal.
Queue up 20 items in the build plan at once, the list is absolutely stacked.
Ghost-mode run: prestige when away time is at least three times the playtime. Only credited away time counts.
Wrap a milestone chain, the bag is secured.
Finish all six milestone chains in one run, the whole arc is done.
Check off every milestone in one run, the to-do list is cooked.
Vibe check: finishing the whole menu.
Collect 15 badges, the shelf is starting to shine.
Rack up 45 badges, the gallery is giving curated.
Pile up 135 badges, the archive has its own zip code.
Hit 400 badges and the Prismatic theme is yours, legend status.
Clear every rung of one lineage ladder, the collection is complete.
Every wonder raised at least once, the skyline is iconic.
Hear out every harbinger there is, the whole cast of drama.
Meet every civilization there is, you've seen the whole map.
Succumb to every era's catastrophe for the Ashfall theme. Dramatic exit, every time.
Endure every era's catastrophe and the Last Passage. The final boss has nothing on you.
A worker went hungry and left the chat, the Snacks ran out.
Dinner drama, and somebody is hungry.
Tank morale far enough that the game flags it, the mood is in shambles.
Mood check: it's not great over there.
Throw 10 festivals in one run, the party never ends.
Sell 100 buildings in one run, the going-out-of-business energy is real.
Clearance rack energy, sell it all.
Gather by hand 1,000 times in one run, the bare-hands bit is iconic.
Pull a successful Legendary mission and bring the bag home, legend status.
The board drops one now and then, stay tuned.
Decline an Ancient Memory with a flat no, respect the boundaries.
Saying no has a whole arc, the RSVP is pending.
Accept an Ancient Memory, we have been here before.
Export an account backup, extra safe, extra cute.
Peek at your recovery code, the secret handshake.
An era opens with a legendary good event, the timing is immaculate.
Weather three rough era events in one run, the glow-up is earned.
Max every storable resource at its cap at the same time, Smoke Szn Age or later. A resource spent as fast as it is made does not count.
Start a run holding ruins from a civilization that fell, heavy lore, free loot.
Inspect a visitor from somewhere else on the map, the alien is a whole vibe.
Look up. The sky has a whole thing going on.
Unlock the developer console, you're in the back room now.
Load a save with the forge master's proof, certified source-code tourist.
Edited outside the game? Load that save, the receipts are sus.
